GeneDef.label: wet nurse
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene lactate continuously once they reach adulthood.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Always lactating. If lactation stops because of severe malnutrition, it resumes once the carrier is fed.
Gene-supported lactation does not reduce fertility.
Male carriers only lactate if male lactation from this gene is allowed in the mod settings.
Requires Fertility Expanded's lactation system to be enabled.
